summary.zh: 记录面向使用者的重要功能、优化和修复。最新版本排在最前。
summary.en: User-facing features, improvements, and fixes, with the newest release first.

title.zh: 研究工作台全新界面与发布候选审计
title.en: Redesigned research workspace and release-candidate audit

text.zh: 全部页面采用统一的研究工作台设计：更清晰的信息层级、一致的操作控件，并保持原有的检索、监测与项目能力。
text.en: All pages now share one research-workspace design: clearer hierarchy and consistent controls, with search, monitoring, and project capabilities unchanged.

text.zh: 页面按路由拆分加载，首次进入更快；深浅主题与中英文界面全面适配。
text.en: Routes load on demand for a faster first open; light/dark themes and the bilingual interface are fully supported.

text.zh: 修复浅色与深色主题下的文字对比度、320px 小屏溢出及移动端表格的键盘可达性问题。
text.en: Fixed text contrast in both themes, small-screen (320px) overflow, and keyboard access to scrollable tables on mobile.

text.zh: 发布候选审计通过：0 严重无障碍违规、三引擎浏览器矩阵、备份恢复演练与打印/导出验证。
text.en: Release-candidate audit passed: zero serious accessibility violations, a three-engine browser matrix, backup/restore drills, and print/export verification.

text.zh: 新增可选的访问认证与 Linux 部署工具包，便于在服务器环境安全运行。
text.en: Added optional access authentication and a Linux deployment kit for safer server operation.

text.zh: 监测主题现可按计划自动运行，并在详情页展示下一次执行时间及运行历史。
text.en: Monitors can now run on schedule and show their next execution time and run history.

text.zh: 修复中文注册源实时检查的浏览器线程故障与错误熔断问题。
text.en: Fixed browser-thread failures and incorrect circuit breaking during live checks of Chinese registries.

text.zh: 补充 Windows 安装说明，并统一监测时间的本地时区显示。
text.en: Added Windows installation guidance and consistent local-time display for monitor timestamps.

text.zh: 新增中文复合词分词回退，提高疾病与检测概念组合检索的召回率。
text.en: Added Chinese compound-term segmentation fallback to improve recall for combined disease and assay concepts.

text.zh: 新增监测频率配置和清晰的“已保存搜索”创建入口。
text.en: Added configurable monitor frequency and a clearer creation path for Saved Searches.

text.zh: 搜索过程增加耗时与分来源进度反馈，减少长查询期间的不确定感。
text.en: Added elapsed-time and per-source progress feedback for long-running searches.

title.zh: 研究工作区与生产就绪

text.zh: 新增研究项目、保存的搜索、笔记与证据、范围化情报仪表盘及自然语言检索。
text.en: Added research projects, saved searches, notes and evidence, scoped intelligence dashboards, and natural-language search.

text.zh: 新增数据源同步历史、来源新鲜度、备份恢复和生产健康检查。
text.en: Added source synchronization history, freshness indicators, backup and recovery, and production health checks.

text.zh: 增强 ChiCTR、CTR、WHO ICTRP 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的发现、补全与一致性处理。
text.en: Improved discovery, enrichment, and consistency handling across ChiCTR, CTR, WHO ICTRP, and ClinicalTrials.gov.
